# Vikram Kamath Cannanure

> Postdoctoral fellow at Saarland University and KCRC Fellow at the Kigali
> Collaborative Research Centre. Works on Thoughtful AI: human-centered systems
> for reflection, care and trust, at the intersection of Human-Computer
> Interaction (HCI) and Information and Communication Technologies for
> Development (ICTD).

Also published as "Vikram Cannanure" and "Vikram Kamath".
PhD in Human-Computer Interaction, Carnegie Mellon University, 2023.

## Topics

Work is organised under three topics, which are also the filters on the homepage
publication list and the first keyword on every paper:

- **Conversational AI** — chatbots, large language models, interactive voice response, microlearning
- **Teacher Learning** — teacher professional development, mentorship at scale, teacher aspirations
- **Global South** — ICTD, asset-based design, community access to health and education information

## Structured data

- [Publications, JSON](https://kmarkiv.com/publications.json): every paper with title, authors, venue, year, DOI, and links
- [Publications, BibTeX](https://kmarkiv.com/assets/publications.bib): the same list as citable BibTeX entries
- [Sitemap](https://kmarkiv.com/sitemap.xml): every indexable page
- Each page carries JSON-LD (schema.org Person and ScholarlyArticle); paper pages also carry Highwire Press `citation_*` tags.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://kmarkiv.com/): biography, research interests, news, publication list, service
- [Research](https://kmarkiv.com/research.html): research agenda and selected work
- [Papers index](https://kmarkiv.com/papers/): one page per publication, each with full metadata and a BibTeX record
- [Thoughtful AI](https://kmarkiv.com/thoughtful-ai/): the research programme

## Notes for automated readers

- The site is static HTML. No content requires JavaScript to render.
- Canonical URL for a paper is its page under /papers/, not the publisher DOI.
- A publication title links to its PDF when one is hosted, opening in a new tab; otherwise it links to the paper's own page.
- "Details" beside each entry always reaches the paper page, which carries the full metadata and BibTeX.
